description: Defines the SocketTracker class for tracking socket states and activities within the starboard namespace, including socket lifecycle events, address management, and idle time computation.

classes.name: SocketTracker
classes.description: A singleton class that manages socket lifecycle events, addresses, and states for tracking purposes.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SocketTracker.

methods.name: OnReceiveFrom
methods.description: Handles receiving data from a socket.

methods.name: OnSendTo
methods.description: Handles sending data to a socket.

methods.name: IsSocketTracked
methods.description: Checks if a socket is being tracked.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of a socket.

methods.name: OnAddWaiter
methods.description: Adds a waiter to a socket.

methods.name: OnRemoveWaiter
methods.description: Removes a waiter from a socket.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Returns the current state of a socket.

methods.name: ComputeIdleTimePerSocketForThreadId
methods.description: Computes idle time per socket for a given thread ID.
